Axiom: IF the SUT returns `Result` — the narrow exception per `AX_RESULT_PUBLIC_BOUNDARY`, not the default shape of a new SUT — use `unwrap()` / `unwrapSync()` on success paths to collapse «check success + extract value» into one call. The assert then focuses solely on the business shape. A throw-style SUT (the canon default) has no Result to unwrap: assert its return value directly and its error paths per `AX_FOCUSED_ERROR_ASSERTIONS`.
